title: 番外假如朔衡变成反派10番外假如朔衡变成反派9
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
面对奉神，妖族和人族同气连枝……？
朔衡面上不动声色，
实则心中是何滋味，恐怕只有他自己一个人知道。
“…道友谬赞。”黑发黑眸的青年笑了笑，笑容中看不出丝毫其他情绪。
柳惊鸿和白知妄也没察觉到什么不对。
“恰好我们这里还有位置，小凰道友和朔道友就一同入座吧。”
朔衡点点头，没有推辞。
几人坐下后没聊两句，整个广场上的妖族就渐渐多了起来。
朔衡左手边是白知妄，右手边是凰天玥，
他俩加一块，能把整个妖族全都给朔衡介绍一遍。
由此，他也算看清了那几位白默桉口中“妖族天骄”的长相。
燎原身高八尺，身形壮硕，浑身皮肤黝黑，一双深红色的眼眸看起来分外血腥瘆人，
不过他的风评倒还不错，并不像外表看上去这么凶悍；
涂山姒是个容貌绝佳的女子，
她不似其他妖族那般化为人形时鲜少保留自己的种族特征，反而大大咧咧的在背后露出九条尾巴，像丝绸一般滑腻雪白；
蚀月是个带着灰色面罩的清瘦男人，他坐在天光垂落却被神树遮蔽的阴影中，一双浅色的眼睛像月光下择人而噬的孤原狼王。
“朔道友可千万别小看了他们三个。”白知妄轻柔的笑笑，“他们在妖族成名已久，突破半圣至少也有数百年的光阴，底蕴不浅，再加上天赋出众——
若是小看了他们，在秘境中可是要吃亏的。”
朔衡挑眉：“听白道友的意思，好像很肯定朔某可以进入神树空间一般。”
白知妄似笑非笑的看他一眼，并未回答。

白泽一族参与了当初的比武大会，
见多识广又不止他百宝商行一家。
论“知识面”这块，白泽一族可从不惧【荒古】中任何一方势力。
凤凰族能认出涅盘圣火并不让人意外；百宝商行中各种各样的宝物众多，收藏琳琅满目到令人艳羡，自然能养出极高极高的眼界；
可他白泽自诩“通天彻地”，又怎会看不出凤凰族打着怎样的算盘？
“这天下机缘，一向有缘者得之。”白知妄不动声色的应道，“朔道友当年一举救下我族中数位族弟，如今我便也报李投桃，跟道友说说这神树空间中的事……”
朔衡当然不会拒绝这样的机会。
刚好，他对夏裕岚也并不十分信任，如今刚好可以验证一下对方给他的消息是否准确。
正在两人闲聊之时。
“快看，那就是——”
伴随着一声惊呼，众人的视线不由自主的落回广场中央。
绚烂的虹光从天而降，隐约可见一道婀娜的身影在其中翩然舞动。
独属于凤凰族的华丽羽翼在半空展开，一瞬间竟比那棵火红烈日般的神树还要耀眼几分。
耳畔传来的凤鸣，
悠扬清冽，像是动听婉转的曲调，令人心旷神怡。
一舞一曲，皆震人心魂。
也正是此时，高台上方，凤凰族的执掌者们陆续现身。
朔衡的目光不动声色的掠过这些人。
凤凰族今日召他前来，高台上在座的有一个算一个，他不信没有人对他体内的涅盘圣火毫无非分之想。
正所谓“一荣俱荣一损俱损”，如今他对凤凰族下手，也不算冤枉他们。

“哇——姐姐真是太美了！”
content_en:
In the face of Feng Shen, the demon race and the human race are united...?
Shuo Heng's face remained calm.
In fact, I am afraid only he himself knows what he feels in his heart.
"...Fellow Taoist, you are so complimentary." The young man with black hair and black eyes smiled, and there was no other emotion in his smile.
Liu Jinghong and Bai Zhiwang didn't notice anything wrong.
"It just so happens that we still have room here, so fellow Daoist Xiaohuang and fellow Taoist Shuo can sit down together."
Shuo Heng nodded without refusing.
After a few people sat down and chatted, there were gradually more monsters in the square.
On Shuoheng's left hand is Bai Zhiwang, and on his right is Huang Tianyue.
Together, they can introduce the entire demon clan to Shuo Heng.
From this, he could finally see the appearance of those "demon geniuses" that Bai Moyu called.
Liao Yuan was eight feet tall, with a strong build, dark skin all over his body, and a pair of crimson eyes that looked particularly bloody and terrifying.
However, his reputation is quite good, and he is not as fierce as he looks on the outside;
Tu Shansi is a woman with excellent appearance.
Unlike other demon clans, she rarely retains her racial characteristics when she takes human form. Instead, she has nine tails exposed from her back, which are as smooth and white as silk;
Eclipse Moon is a thin man wearing a gray mask. He is sitting in the shadow of the falling sky but blocked by the sacred tree. His light-colored eyes are like a lone wolf king who chooses and devours people under the moonlight.
"Fellow Daoist Shuo, please don't underestimate the three of them." Bai Zhiwang smiled softly, "They have been famous in the demon clan for a long time. It took at least hundreds of years to break through to the semi-saint level. They have a lot of background and outstanding talents -
If you underestimate them, you will suffer a loss in the secret realm. "
Shuo Heng raised his eyebrows: "From what Fellow Daoist Bai said, it seems very certain that Shuo can enter the sacred tree space."
Bai Zhiwang looked at him with a half-smile but did not answer.
The Bai Ze clan participated in the original martial arts tournament.
He is not the only one who is well-informed and knowledgeable.
When it comes to "knowledge", the Bai Ze clan has never been afraid of any force in [Ancient Times].
It is not surprising that the Phoenix Clan can recognize the Holy Fire of Nirvana; there are many kinds of treasures in the Baobao Trading Company, and the collection is so dazzling that it is enviable, and it is natural to cultivate a very high vision;
But Bai Ze claims to be "all over the world", so how could he not see what the Phoenix Clan is planning?
"Opportunities in this world are always found by those who are destined to do so." Bai Zhiwan responded calmly, "Fellow Taoist Shuo saved several members of my clan in one fell swoop back then. Now I will repay Li Toutao and tell fellow Taoist Taoist what happened in the sacred tree space..."
Of course Shuo Heng would not refuse such an opportunity.
It just so happened that he didn't trust Xia Yulan very much, and now he could verify whether the information the other party gave him was accurate.
While the two were chatting.
"Look, that's——"
With an exclamation, everyone's eyes involuntarily fell back to the center of the square.
Brilliant rainbow light fell from the sky, and a graceful figure could be vaguely seen dancing gracefully in it.
The gorgeous wings that belong to the Phoenix clan spread out in mid-air, and for an instant they were even more dazzling than the sacred tree that was as red as the scorching sun.
The sound of phoenix ringing in my ears,
It is melodious and clear, like a beautiful and melodious melody, which makes people feel relaxed and happy.
Every dance and every song touches the heart and soul.
It was at this time that the leaders of the Phoenix Clan appeared one after another above the high platform.
Shuo Heng's eyes passed over these people calmly.
The Phoenix Clan summoned him today, and everyone present on the high platform could not believe that no one had any inklings about the Nirvana Holy Fire in his body.
As the saying goes, "Everyone is prosperous and everyone suffers." Now that he is attacking the Phoenix Clan, it is not an injustice to them.
"Wow - sister is so beautiful!"
